95249: Após oito anos do término da trama original, uma nova geração dos jovens de Upper East Sider terá seus segredos revelados quando uma nova Gossip Girl entra em ação.
101137: A documentary series exploring the myths and legends behind some of Hollywood’s notoriously “cursed” horror film productions. From plane accidents and bombings during the making of The Omen, to the rumored use of real human skeletons on the set of Poltergeist, these stories are legendary amongst film fans and filmmakers alike. But where does the truth lie?
